## Description

Please include a summary of the change and the motivation behind it. If this PR resolves an issue, please reference it below (e.g. `Fixes #123`).

## Type of Change

- [ ] :bug: Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] :sparkles: New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] :satellite: Data / Station / UKE Registry update
- [ ] :memo: Documentation update
- [ ] :wrench: Tooling / CI / Infrastructure change

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's code style and Conventional Commits guidelines.
- [ ] I have verified locally using `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run build`.
- [ ] Existing functionality continues to work as expected.
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated if applicable.
